verdict.line: You win by using Jousting's reach to dictate when fights happen and punishing Riven's 13s Q cooldown, but you lose if you dismount near her Ki Burst stun or get caught by her post-6 burst out of vision.

brief.thesis: Kled's Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 800 range) and E (Jousting, 550 range) out-reach every tool in Riven's kit (275/260/250 range), so mounted Kled controls when trades start. That edge shows up as lane and solo-kill advantage for you, but Riven's Ki Burst stun and Blade of the Exile burst at level 6 can flip an extended trade in her favor, which is why the 54-game head-to-head still sits at an even 50%.

theirWindow.what: Blade of the Exile gives her bonus AD, range, and a Wind Slash poke she can throw before you see her coming back. Don't walk up to trade blind after she disappears near level 6-8; wait for a ward or her Q charges to confirm she's not about to all-in.

yourWindow.what: Jousting in and immediately recasting E to dash back out punishes Riven's Q (Broken Wings), which is a flat 13s cooldown at every rank. Dash in right after she burns her Q combo, land autos, and dash back before she can reset with another ability.

start.why: Sits at 48.2% WR over 56 games and 90.3% pick rate here; the lifesteal and AD keep you winning extended Jousting trades before your first back.

boots.why: 50% over 4 games against Mercury's Treads but Steelcaps carries 85.7% of pick share at 47.9% WR; the flat physical damage reduction blunts Riven's empowered-auto passive (Runic Blade) and her Q/W/R burst.

core.why: Boosts your mounted auto and E damage and adds the HP that keeps Skaarl alive through Riven's stun-into-burst windows.
Matches the highest-sample core path (50% WR, 6 games, 14.3% pick) and rewards the splitpush pressure Kled's reach already gives you in this lane.
Caps the top build path with HP and bonus damage, letting you shrug off Riven's all-in burst and punish her for committing.

her Blade of the Exile burst is deleting you post-6

runes.keystoneWhy: Jousting in and out to poke stacks Conqueror over repeated trades, and the healing conversion keeps you ahead in skirmishes against Riven's burst.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 74.6% of games here at 42% WR and lines up with Kled's measured solo-kill advantage in this matchup — Ignite closes out the all-ins your Jousting range sets up.

playing.title: Joust in right after her Q
playing.detail: Broken Wings (Q) is a flat 13-second cooldown at every rank. Dash in with E as soon as she commits her three-hit combo and dash back out before Ki Burst (W) comes off cooldown.

playing.title: Bait Valor before committing Q
playing.detail: Valor (E) blocks one incoming instance of damage on a 10-6s cooldown. Throw an auto or weak poke to force it out, then land your Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) for the real damage and yank.

playing.title: Never facetank near full Runic Blade stacks
playing.detail: Riven's passive empowers her next auto after using an ability. If she's just cast Q, W, or E, back off a step instead of trading face-to-face.

playing.title: Track your own mount state constantly
playing.detail: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and swaps Q for Pocket Pistol. Don't initiate a long trade if Skaarl's health is low enough to dismount mid-fight.

playing.title: Play safe around level 6 ambushes
playing.detail: Once Riven hits 6, don't walk up on missing information. Blade of the Exile's range and Wind Slash let her punish a blind approach before you can react.

playing.title: Push your Hydra spike into all-ins
playing.detail: Once Titanic Hydra completes, your sustained damage and Skaarl's health pool outscale her short trades. Force fights in this window before her second item comes online.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the matchup reasoning (why the trades, timings, and windows play out this way) is my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Jousting [E] to keep your distance while punishing Riven to easily gain control over lane. Be careful of being ambushed after she reaches level 6, especially when she is out of sight.
